title: The nervous system lies inside the body it feels

statements.text: In any complex organism the nervous system lies entirely within the body, which allows a two-way dialogue: the body signals injury, and the nervous system both produces pain and acts chemically to repair damage and reduce the pain. Nothing comparable holds between the nervous system and the outside world.

sources.quote: in any complex organism, the nervous system is entirely located within the perimeter of the body
Notably, there is nothing comparable in the relation between the nervous system and the universe that surrounds our organisms.
